correctness.rationale: Perfect matchings of the n-prism with rungs correspond to cyclic monomer-dimer coverings, plus two extra zero-rung horizontal configurations for even n, giving Z=alpha^n+beta^n+2*[n even]. Differentiation and pinned-rung path factorizations yield the exact two-point probabilities. A geometric Fourier sum over the two transfer roots gives Lambda_j=p_n 4cos²(pi j/n)/(lambda²+4cos²), j !=0, while Lambda_0=lambda p_n prime>0 by variance. The only nonconstant zero occurs at even n, j=n/2. Extremal retained cos² values are cos²(pi/n) and sin²(pi/n) even or sin²(pi/(2n)) odd; their ratio and both c/n limits follow directly. Independent full prism-matching enumeration n=3..8 at lambda=.8 checked probabilities and all nonzero Fourier eigenvalues numerically to 1e-9.
